newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic signs AT&T interconnect pact.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic signs AT&T interconnect pact.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp said on Tuesday that it has signed local interconnection and resale agreements with AT&T Corp for service in Maryland and Virginia.
Approvals from the Maryland Public Service Commission and the Virginia State Corporation Commission are expected to come within a month, Bell Atlantic said in a statement.
AT&T's presence in the local telephone market will enable Bell Atlantic to offer long distance service under the Telecommunications Act of 1996, Bell Atlantic said.
